title: The original etale exchange and its actual three-arrow diagram
statement: For a commutative square and an etale bounded-below complex L, construct the four-vertex exchange diagram from the actual etale derived adjunctions and pullback-square comparison. Cache the original Etale.baseChange component with these endpoints, without changing its value. It equals the diagram composite. Every functor maps this original total to the composite of the mapped diagram. No geometric or invertibility hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Build the actual etale adjunction exchange diagram and define its total to be the original baseChange component. Reflexivity proves the cache equation.

Rewrite the two actual derived adjunctions by their proved equality with derivedPlus. Apply the existing baseChange_app_eq_mateEquiv theorem and the generic mate_eq_exchangeChain_composite theorem. Finally use the generic endpoint-typed mapHom_composite equation for every target functor. Its mapHom_eq equation proves that this typed map is precisely the original functor map.
Unfold mapHom and the typed etale component to identify the entire mapped Arrow object with the original functor image of etale base change.
